name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Lifecycle & Digital Adoption | Behavior-Triggered Programs, Scaled CS & Agentic Workflows
summary: Lifecycle and customer success operator who builds post-sale programs end to end: segmentation, triggers, copy, build, and measurement. Built a 20+ workflow lifecycle system covering onboarding, nurture, reactivation, and reviews, and designs AI agents that interpret a business's situation and decide the next touch. Comes from the customer side: retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye using utilization data and automated product-training sequences, and onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix. Writes plainly for technical and non-technical readers alike, with 18 published articles on automation, analytics, and AI search.
